analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the "Last updated" date and adds one table row (head line 1387) for `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`. The row describes a paged complete-store token floor for dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and links to prefix-cache.md#streamed-complete-checkpoints. The supplied units (head lines 1608-2422) are unchanged surrounding documentation. I read them for context and found no changed text there. The patch excerpt is truncated, but the range map is complete (head changes only at lines 3 and 1387). The changed row is not in the supplied units, so it could not be checked line by line.

No code, config or security-control changes are visible. The change touches the prefix cache described in T-041 (TB-007, A-001). The row only documents a checkpoint-boundary heuristic: where a range ends when it saves at least a token floor. The text does not widen the at-rest surface, change the TTL, change HMAC lookup names, change salt scoping, or loosen the donation gate. Those are the T-041 detection-hint items, and none changed in the visible text.

Open question for the next pass: the underlying implementation in EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift and the paged complete store is not in this batch. If that code changed, it needs review against T-041 and SEC-035. That review should check that a demanded latest checkpoint is still persisted only via the per-donation gate, HMAC-tagged names and cacheSalt folding. The code is out of supplied evidence, so I record this as an unverified contract, not a finding.
